title: Trajectory cadence, capacity & readiness worksheet
summary: Working worksheet to align launch cadence to available capacity + KPI targets. Mix of numbers, quick sims, and checklist items we iterate on in weekly ops sync.
purpose: Create a single runnable view for product ops + eng + SRE to decide cadence (phases), staffing commits, and go/no-go thresholds for staged rollouts.
kpi_rows: Per-token latency P95 <= 120ms | 120ms | Eng | 110ms | 150ms | Shift to canary / reduce batch size | daily
Error-rate (5xx) <= 0.3% | 0.3% | SRE | 0.12% | 0.5% | Pause rollout + investigate | hourly
Cost per 1k tokens (hosted) <= $0.85 | $0.85 | Finance/Product | $0.72 | $1.10 | Turn on cost cap routing | weekly
Model-quality regressions (eval set delta) <= -2% | -2% | Research/Prod | 0% | -4% | Rollback model variant | per-release
roadmap_rows: Phase A - Internal Pilot | target users: 10 orgs | window: 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-21 | capacity goal: 5k req/day | owners: Product + SE | notes: focus on latency/cost baseline
Phase B - Early Adopter Cohort | target users: 50 orgs | window: 2026-03-22 to 2026-04-18 | capacity goal: 30k req/day | owners: Dedicated team + SRE | notes: stress autoscale and KV cache hit rates

Phase C - Public Beta (limited) | target users: 1k orgs | window: 2026-04-20 to 2026-05-31 | capacity goal: 200k req/day | owners: GTM + ProdOps | notes: observe cost per token and enable routing rules

Phase D - Gradual Scale | open signup with throttles | window: 2026-06-01 onward | capacity goal: 1M req/day steady-state | owners: Platform Eng + Infra | notes: bring Dedicated capacity online as needed
capacity_assumptions: GPU pool A (r5) sustained: 4 p95 120ms instances -> ~75k tokens/min
KV cache expected hit: 18% -> reduces token compute by ~12%
Batching window defaults 15ms; ramp to 30ms for cost slope experiments
Autoscale cold-start buffer: reserve 10% headroom for sudden spikes
On-prem private customers are isolated; do not count towards hosted burst capacity
readiness_checklist: Telemetry: per-route traces and token-cost breakdown present (yes/no) -> owner: Observability
Rollout policy: canary + auto-fallback configured -> owner: Product/Rollouts
SLA docs published + legal reviewed for pilot customers -> owner: Legal
Support runbook: first-48h incident playbook and escalation tree -> owner: CS/SRE
Capacity test: 1.2x target sustained for 30m without >1% error-rate -> owner: SRE
Regression harness: evaluation set run against every model variant pre-rollout -> owner: Research
Billing limits: cost caps and per-token budgets applied for pilot orgs -> owner: Finance
action_items: (A) Run 2-hour capacity sim with synthetic traffic matching early-adopter mix - assignee: Ethan - due 2026-02-21
(B) Finalize canary thresholds and alert runbook - assignee: Liam - due 2026-02-25
(C) Map customer cohorts to traffic profiles (low/med/high) - assignee: Sofia - due 2026-02-28
(D) Create cost-shed policy draft for >$1.00/1k tokens - assignee: Finance - due 2026-03-05
(E) Prep CS onboarding playbook for pilot cohort - assignee: Priya - due 2026-03-08
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Underestimated KV cache miss rate -> Mitigation: tighten cache TTLs and prewarm popular prefixes
Risk: Model quality drift post-quantization -> Mitigation: pre-release eval and fallback to FP16 variant
Risk: Unexpected burst from partner integration -> Mitigation: per-org token caps + burst token bucket
Risk: Billing anomalies during ramp -> Mitigation: enable real-time cost monitors and auto-throttle
